messages.呼吸と出血で強化されるS1〜S3を振り回す斬撃アタッカー。呼吸を自力では維持しに: A Slash attacker whose S1–S3 gain bonuses from Poise and Bleed. She struggles to sustain Poise alone and performs best with outside Poise support. Bow's Glimmer [閃弓] offers a way to turn a turn spent unable to attack into greater damage later.
messages.呼吸と出血による強化: S1「刈り取る」は自分の呼吸と対象の出血の合計4以上でコ: **Poise and Bleed bonuses**: S1 Cleave gains +1 Coin Power if her Poise plus the target's Bleed totals at least 4. S2 Positioning Maneuver and S3 Glimmering Bow gain Clash Power/Coin Power for every 4 of that total, and +11% damage for every 4 Poise she has, up to 44%. The Poise-based bonuses do not activate without Poise.
messages.乏しい呼吸: 自前で得られる呼吸はS1で1/2、S2・S3のコインで1/2程度に: **Scarce Poise**: Her own Poise gain is only about 1/2 from S1 and 1/2 from the Coins of S2 and S3. Her main stage is the Mirror Dungeon, where E.G.O Gifts can make up for Poise. Yi Sang's Blade Lineage Salsu support passive Bestow (the 1 ally with the highest SP gains +1 whenever they gain Poise Count from a skill effect) and the E.G.O Thoracalgia can also help.
messages.出血: S3のⅢコインで出血4、S2・S3で出血回数も増やす。: **Bleed**: Coin Ⅲ of S3 inflicts 4 Bleed, and S2 and S3 also increase Bleed Count.
messages.「閃弓」: 守備「弓刀展開」のターン終了時、矢-死が1以上なら狙撃姿勢と目標照準: **Bow's Glimmer**: At Turn End after using the Defense skill Unfold Bowblade, if she has at least 1 Arrow - Shi, she gains Ready to Loose and 1 Target Aim. From then on, her leftmost basic attack skill becomes Bow's Glimmer, an unclashable shot fired at Combat Start. Each turn she uses no attack skill grants +1 Target Aim, up to 4. Each Target Aim raises damage and Critical damage, and at 4 she gains +444% Critical damage. While in Ready to Loose, damage does not stagger her. It is cancelled if she starts combat with an E.G.O skill equipped.
messages.基本はS1〜S3でマッチし、呼吸と出血で威力を伸ばす。呼吸は外部の補助で維持する: By default, Clash with S1–S3 and raise their power with Poise and Bleed. Maintain Poise with external support. Bow's Glimmer means giving up Clashes while charging, and the damage rarely justifies that. Do not use it routinely; limit it to situations where she cannot attack anyway, such as bosses whose powerful skills force the turn to end, and charge Target Aim then fire.
